question: Why does the merging of light into light differ from a mere multitude of meters attaining self-will?
premises: A multitude of meters is contrasted.
That multitude does not attain self-will.
inference: True nondual merging is not equivalent to an aggregate plurality gaining autonomy.
uncertainties: The metaphorical link between meters and freedom is compressed.
plain_english: Light goes into light; nor does a mere multitude of meters attain self-will.
